job: Set one switch for each category and channel in a grid.
purpose: A category by channel grid: a mono header row, one row per category and a fixed-width column per channel (data-cols 1 to 6). Each cell holds a switch or checkbox with an aria-label that names both the row and the column.
useWhen: Notification settings: events down the side, email, browser and phone across the top.
Permissions by role or by resource where every cell is on or off.

avoidWhen.when: There is one column of independent settings.
The grid shows data, not controls.

variants.useWhen: Two channel columns, such as email and browser.
Six channel columns; the most that fit.

parts.role: The header row with channel names.
Holds the row label and description.

keyboard.does: Moves through the controls row by row.
Flips the focused switch or checkbox.
